Our client, located in the Beveren region, is looking for a Supervisor Piping & Mechanical with strong technical expertise and people leadership skills.
 
 

• You’ll lead, coordinate and supervise daily piping and mechanical maintenance activities with a strong focus on HSE, quality, cost control and operational continuity 

• You’ll plan, prioritize and allocate maintenance work to ensure efficient execution of both preventive and corrective maintenance activities 

• You’ll organize daily toolbox meetings, communicate priorities and ensure compliance with all safety procedures and permit-to-work requirements 

• You’ll actively supervise field activities and provide technical support to technicians and contractors during the execution of maintenance work 

• You’ll coordinate closely with Operations, Engineering, Reliability and Inspection departments to align maintenance priorities and ensure efficient plant availability 

• You’ll ensure the safe and efficient execution of maintenance activities on piping systems, pressure vessels, heat exchangers, storage tanks and other static equipment 

• You’ll safeguard the mechanical integrity of plant assets by ensuring that maintenance and repair activities are executed according to engineering standards, site procedures and applicable regulations 

• You’ll support inspection programs and follow up on findings, integrity assessments, statutory inspections and corrective actions 

• You’ll coordinate and manage external contractors, ensuring compliance with safety, quality, planning and budget requirements 

• You’ll monitor work quality and verify that repairs, modifications and installations are completed according to specifications and industry standards 

• You’ll support the preparation, execution and evaluation of shutdowns, turnarounds and maintenance projects 

• You’ll drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on reliability, safety, efficiency and maintenance performance 

• You’ll ensure accurate maintenance administration and reporting in SAP, including work order completion, time registration and maintenance history 
 

• You have a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a comparable technical qualification, or equivalent by experience 

• You have at least 5 years of relevant maintenance experience within the petrochemical, chemical, oil & gas or related process industry 

• You’re experienced in a supervisory, team leader or coordination role within an industrial environment 

• You have solid knowledge of piping systems, pressure equipment, heat exchangers, storage tanks and other static equipment 

• You have a good understanding of mechanical integrity principles, inspection methodologies and reliability-driven maintenance practices 

• You have a strong knowledge of HSE requirements, permit-to-work systems, contractor management and process safety 

• You’re experienced with SAP or another CMMS system and good proficiency in Microsoft Office applications 

• You own strong planning, organizational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to effectively manage changing priorities 

• You have excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, enabling effective collaboration across multiple disciplines 

• You are fluent in Dutch and have a good command of English 

• You have a hands-on leadership style with the ability to motivate, coach and develop people

For a company in the Waregem region, we are looking for an all-round (multi-skilled) employee. You will work in a company that processes second-hand clothing.

What does the job involve?

• You assist with the initial sorting process (on top of the sorting installation).
• You are responsible for removing and transporting the initially sorted items.
• You assist our drivers with manual unloading.

• Dynamic
• Good physical condition
• Insightful, able to work independently
• No dust allergy
• Forklift experience + certificate = a plus
• You speak French / English or Dutch fluently

Our client is a leading international retail organization operating across multiple countries. This company is investing heavily in the modernization and optimization of its technology landscape, with SAP playing a central role in supporting business operations and future growth.As part of its ongoing digital transformation journey, the organization is strengthening its SAP Retail team to enhance business processes, improve operational efficiency, and support strategic initiatives across procurement, supply chain, inventory management, pricing, and store operations.As IT SAP Retail Consultant, you will join a team of experienced professionals working closely with stakeholders across business and IT functions to deliver impactful solutions that support the organization's long-term ambitions.

As Senior SAP Retail Business Consultant, you will be responsible for supporting, optimizing, and evolving SAP Retail solutions across the end-to-end retail value chain.Your key responsibilities will include:

• Supporting and enhancing SAP Retail business processes across procurement, inventory management, assortment management, pricing, replenishment, logistics, and store operations.
• Gathering business requirements and translating them into functional specifications and effective SAP solutions.
• Configuring SAP Retail functionalities and ensuring alignment with SAP best practices.
• Driving process standardization and continuous improvement initiatives across business units and countries.
• Providing 2nd and 3rd line functional support, investigating incidents, identifying root causes, and coordinating issue resolution.
• Contributing to SAP transformation and S/4HANA-related projects by participating in workshops, solution design activities, testing, and deployment initiatives.
• Collaborating with business users, project teams, implementation partners, and external service providers.
• Supporting system integrations with eCommerce platforms, warehouse management solutions, financial applications, POS systems, EDI interfaces, and other third-party solutions.
• Assisting data migration activities and promoting data quality and governance best practices.
• Acting as a trusted advisor for business stakeholders while mentoring junior team members and facilitating knowledge transfer.
• Ensuring the stability, performance, and long-term sustainability of SAP Retail solutions

To succeed in this role, you will combine strong SAP Retail expertise with excellent stakeholder management and problem-solving capabilities.You ideally bring:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Supply Chain, or a related field.
• At least 8 years of SAP experience, including a minimum of 5 years focused on SAP Retail.
• Proven experience working within large-scale retail organizations and complex international environments.
• Strong expertise in:
• SAP Retail
• SAP MM
• SAP SD
• Assortment Management
• Article Master Data
• Purchasing Processes
• Inventory Management
• Invoice Verification
• Retail Pricing
• Exposure to SAP S/4HANA Retail, SAP CAR, SAP Datasphere, SAP BTP, or SAP Integration Suite would be considered a strong advantage.
• Solid understanding of retail and supply chain business processes.
• Experience in solution design, requirements gathering, testing, and change management.
• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
• Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities.
• The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
• Fluency in English and either French or Dutch.

Since 1854, Katoen Natie has grown from a Belgian family business into a global logistics powerhouse with operations spanning five continents. Based in the strategic Gent Port, we specialize in warehousing, transport, cargo handling, and supply chain solutions for international clients. Our success stems from combining 170  years of expertise with innovative technology and a personal, SME approach to business.Join our dynamic team where tradition meets innovation, and every day brings new challenges in the exciting world of international logistics.

Jobomschrijving

THE OPPORTUNITYWe're seeking an experienced Warehouse Team Leader to join our operations team at our state-of-the-art facility in Gent Zeehaven. This is a hands-on leadership role where you'll guide, inspire, and work alongside a dedicated team of warehouse professionals while ensuring operational excellence in our fast-paced international logistics environment.YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Team Leadership: Coach and motivate warehouse staff to consistently achieve operational KPIs and quality standardsOperational Planning: Create efficient work schedules, allocate resources, and optimize workflow processesHands-On Management: Lead by example - work directly with your team using forklifts and warehouse equipment when neededPerformance Management: Monitor team performance, provide feedback, and implement improvement initiativesCritical Decision Making: Make quick, effective decisions during peak periods and tight deadline situationsSafety & Compliance: Ensure all safety protocols and quality standards are maintained at all timesReporting: Provide regular updates to warehouse supervisors and operational managementContinuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to enhance efficiency and reduce operational costs

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:Essential Requirements:

3  years of team leadership experience in warehouse, logistics, or distribution environmentsForklift certification (or commitment to obtain certification within 30 days)Strong communication skills in Dutch and English (French is a plus)Proven track record of meeting KPIs and managing operational deadlinesPhysical stamina for hands-on warehouse work and extended periods on your feetFlexible schedule - ability to work various shifts including occasional weekendsProblem-solving mindset with ability to make decisions under pressure

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or related field or equal through experienceExperience with WMS (Warehouse Management Systems)Knowledge of customs procedures and international shippingLean/Six Sigma certification or continuous improvement experienceMultilingual capabilities for our international client base

What will you do?  

• Through using different Integration Services, you will develop and implement integration solutions.  
• Collaborate with other (senior) team members in the areas of security, networking, infrastructure and overall IT architecture.  
• You will dive into creating and implementing robust backend API frameworks and messaging solutions tailored for distributed environments.  
• Work with highly challenging projects, both technically and functionally  
• By being a team player, you help our clients with their digitalization challenges.  
 

Who are we looking for? 

• Someone with experience in diverse technical environments and is eager and interested to further expand his/her knowledge in the integration domain.  
• You want to deepen and broaden your skills regarding Hybrid Cloud Integration Platforms, API’s and Microservices. 
• Great interest in technology and corresponding new evolutions such as DevOps leveraging Kubernetes or Security with OpenID Connect 
• Excellent communication skills in English, Dutch is a nice plus 
• Thrives in a hybrid environment, but is also willing to commute to Antwerp, Brussels, or Ghent on a regular basis. 
• Education level minimum Bachelor or equivalent through experience.

As a warehouse worker in Wevelgem, you will be involved in the entire logistics process, from receiving to shipping goods. Every day, you use an electric pallet truck, forklift, and handheld scanner. You make sure everything is stored properly, orders are ready on time, and the warehouse stays tidy.
Your day starts between 7 and 8 AM, depending on your training. You pick orders, load and unload trucks and containers, and handle the administrative tasks related to shipments. For this, you use a PC, printer, and ERP system. You carry out simple visual checks and make sure everything runs safely and according to company guidelines. You actively participate in the daily team meeting with your colleagues and support each other.
Ready to roll up your sleeves and feel at home in a warehouse? Apply quickly and make a difference in a growing company!

You speak and write fluent Dutch (preferably), and/or English and/or French.You have a certificate for electric pallet truck and forklift.Experience in a warehouse environment is a plus.You work accurately and with a focus on quality.You are flexible and have a hands-on attitude.You enjoy working in a team and communicate respectfully.You actively participate in the daily team meeting.

As a Welder, you are responsible for welding aluminum profiles with quality and precision. You make sure every profile is processed according to the agreed guidelines, playing an important role in the production of design lighting fixtures.

A typical day includes operating the welding robot or TIG welding machine, preparing and cutting profiles, and setting the rolling machine. Together with your colleagues, you follow up on the order lists to ensure everything is completed accurately and on time. You work with great attention to detail and strive for a neat end result each time.

Are you passionate about technology and enjoy working with your hands? Do you want to be part of a team where you help create unique products? Apply quickly and discover this opportunity!

• Technical background
• Training in metalwork is a plus
• Experience as a welder (aluminum)
• You work accurately and pay attention to detail
• Good knowledge of Dutch or English

Are you the Incident Manager we’re looking for?

We are looking for an experienced Incident / Problem Manager to join an Application Support team based in Brussels.

You will play a key role in managing application-related incidents and problems, with a strong focus on reducing recurring incidents, improving service stability, and driving continuous improvement.

You will join a small, collaborative team and work closely with technical and application support teams to ensure incidents are effectively managed, root causes are identified, and appropriate corrective actions are implemented.
Role
• Manage the end-to-end Incident Management process for application-related incidents.
• Lead and coordinate the Problem Management process, including root cause analysis and corrective actions.
• Monitor and follow up on application-related incidents, ensuring appropriate prioritisation and resolution.
• Identify trends and recurring incidents and implement actions to reduce incident volumes.
• Support the management of incidents across different priority levels, including P3–P4.
• Monitor application environments using Datadog.
• Work with ServiceNow for incident and problem management.
• Analyse incident trends and identify opportunities for service improvement.
• Collaborate with application, infrastructure, and technical teams to resolve complex issues.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of application support and IT service management processes.
• Participate in an on-call rotation, currently expected to be approximately one week in three. Out-of-hours incident volumes are currently low.
Profile
We are looking for someone with a backgound Incident Management, Problem Management, or Application Support experience.

You should have:

• Proven experience in Incident Management and/or Problem Management or Support engineering. .
• Previous experience within an Application Support environment.
• Experience working with ServiceNow.
• Experience with Datadog or a similar monitoring solution.
• Good working knowledge of SQL.
• A hands-on approach and the ability to work closely with technical teams.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Good communication and stakeholder-management skills.
• The ability to work effectively in a small, collaborative team.
• Fluent/professional English.

You will be modelling a highly diverse set of treatment processes and plants for water industry
 

clients worldwide, with the goal of reducing greenhouse gas emissions, improving waterquality,
 

saving resources and making plants smart. By mastering and applying modelling techniques such
 

as bio/chemical kinetics, computational fluid dynamics (CFD) or the combination, you will unravel
 

what is happening inside water treatment systems and will be able to improve processes
 

significantly. After a while, you will be able to execute rather spectacular modelling work, for which
 

AM-Team is known. The complexity of the modelling projects will grow along with and will be
 

adjusted to your modelling knowledge and experience. You will also be developing a broad
 

knowledge on existing and novel industry processes.
 

The objectives of your modelling projects will be highly case dependent, but mostly you will make
 

clients happy by saving costs, saving energy, improving technology and competitive position,
 

accelerating technology development, and improving process performance and reliability.
 

Main responsibilities
 

• 
Project execution & delivery: Executing multiple modelling projects & delivery of the
 

project outcomes to the customers in the shape of reports and presentations. Typically,
 

projects execution involves. 2/3
 

Job offering – Solution Engineer
 

o Understanding project objectives & gathering relevant data
 

o Planning project milestones and executing projects in a stepwise & collaborative
 

manner.
 

o Organizing client meetings and preparing presentations & reports.
 

o Supporting other team members with expert knowledge.
 

• 
Technical communication & dissemination: Internal & external communication on
 

projects and at international events or in online webinars. Writing technical abstracts,
 

journal articles and social media technical blogs or posts.
 

• 
Research & development: Developing new modelling solutions tailored to market needs
 

in close collaboration with the team. Creating templates and SOPs for existing modelling
 

methods.
 

• 
Coaching & training: Continuous learning & improving through active trainings. Also
 

coaching others.
 

You will be guided by senior colleagues at the start and will gradually grow and do your work more
 

autonomously.

• Has at least 2-3 years of water or wastewater industry or relevant academic experience
 

related to working with modelling projects.
 

• Has at least MSc in (environmental/bioscience or relevant) engineering. Has strong
 

understanding and educational background of water treatment processes and/or
 

modelling of these processes. Knowledge and experience with CFD modelling is a plus.
 

• Deeply shares AM-Team’s core values.
 

o We value the fun factor: working with us makes you smile and makes us smile.
 

o Why should the sky be the limit? You are a person that is not afraid to think out of
 

the box and set ambitious goals.
 

o A team is so much more than a bunch of individuals: you are a true team player.
 

o We tailor to enhance value but fit for purpose: we stand for quality and the tailoring
 

of our approach to our team and customers.
 

o We have no boundary conditions: we have no geographical, cultural, or technical
 

boundaries.
 

o We never settle, and keep stirring, we want to infinitely learn and improve, both as
 

team and individuals
 

• Is interested in the wonder world of digitalisation and has passion for innovation.
 

• Is eager to learn and curious.
 

• Has ability to ask the right questions and carefully listen to clients to help them maximally
 

and truly understand their needs and problems.
 

• Has good (self) organisational skills and takes initiative.
 

• Has good presentation skills and can explain things simply, even when they are complex.
 

• Is fluent in English both written and orally - knowledge of another language is a plus (e.g.
 

Dutch, French, or German).

A technical role that makes models and digital twins deliver lasting value at the global scale
 

We’re looking for a water-passioned person that loves combining the water and wastewater
 

treatment side with data, models and digital twins. This role focuses on translating models and
 

data into real value for end customers at the global scale. Beyond the buzz. You will be working
 

in our technical team and will also be interacting regularly with our sales team.

• Has at least 3 years of water or wastewater industry or relevant academic experience related
 

to working with data, mechanistic modelling or hybrid modelling projects.
 

• Has an MSc in (environmental/bioscience or relevant) engineering. Has strong understanding of water treatment processes and associated modelling / data handling of those.
 

• Preferably has specific expertise in data science applications for (waste)water treatment
 

• Is willing to be working from our office in Ghent, Belgium
 

• Has good communication skills and can explain complex matter to customers
 

• Is fluent in English, both written and orally - knowledge of another language is a plus
 

• Shares our company values
 
 

• Transformative digital thought leadership: With the work we do, we don’t just create impact and improve things. We transform the water industry by providing cutting-edge digital solutions. 

• Innovation that solves: We dare to push boundaries and see innovation as a necessity in today’s world. However, dreaming is not enough. Practicality matters as well. Innovative thinking + practicality = impact 

• Together we are one team and pursue shared ambitions: A team is much more than a bunch of individuals. We believe we need people that are different in skills and similar in values to achieve big things

jobs.description:
Our client is the European subsidiary of a global leader in advanced alloys used in high-specification industries such as aerospace, medical, and energy.The European headquarters hosts a truly multicultural team within a friendly, people-focused environment that combines the stability of a world-class manufacturer with the agility of a rapidly scaling organisation. With ambitious growth plans across Europe and an exponentially expanding customer base, the company offers significant long-term career opportunities, internal mobility prospects, and the chance to contribute to a business positioned at the forefront of technical innovation.

Jobomschrijving

While full technical training is provided, your mission will be to ensure an excellent commercial experience for European customers and supporting the full sales cycle:

• Act as the main point of contact for customers in your assigned region, ensuring accurate verbal and written communication of all requirements.
• Manage inquiries, quotations, and orders, and coordinate with production, logistics, and technical teams across Europe and the U.S.
• Organise shipments of finished goods to European customers and follow up proactively on delivery status.
• Maintain and monitor inventory levels (general, custom, and market stock) and provide recommendations to management.
• Navigate strict quality, export compliance, and internal process requirements linked to aerospace-grade products.
• Solve day-to-day issues independently, escalating only when needed.
• Participate in weekly team meetings, one-to-ones, and ongoing coaching sessions with a dedicated local trainer.
• Contribute to continuous improvement and special internal projects.

The client is not looking for someone who has done this job before, but for a high-potential personality eager to grow, learn, and take ownership. Personality & Attitude :

• Ambitious, eager to accelerate their career and take on more responsibility over time (leadership, global exposure, or project ownership).
• Intellectually agile, quick to absorb large amounts of technical information.
• Exceptionally organised and structured, able to prioritise in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
• Assertive and confident on the phone, someone who proactively calls stakeholders rather than relying on emails.
• Open-minded, positive, and energetic, with strong resilience and stress resistance.
• Solution-oriented, able to anticipate issues and think ahead (plan B mindset).
• Comfortable dealing with demanding or high-level stakeholders, including U.S.-based teams.
Background & Experience :The company welcomes talent from diverse sectors or any environment requiring:

• High customer interaction
• Complex coordination
• Strong communication & reactivity
Technical & Language Skills :

• Fluent in English (C-level) is mandatory
• At least B2 level in Italian is required for customer interactions
• Affinity with technical topics, curiosity and willingness to learn about complex products

Step into a rewarding role as a Lift Technician where your technical prowess will keep crucial lift systems running smoothly. You’ll be part of a dedicated team responsible for installation, maintenance, and repair services, ensuring safety and reliability. Your daily tasks will include troubleshooting, performing mechanical and electrical maintenance, and collaborating closely with clients and team members to deliver top-notch service. 

An average day will see you working independently on various customer sites, primarily within the province of Antwerp. You'll tackle a range of mechanical and electrical challenges, ensuring each lift is operating safely and efficiently. Your problem-solving skills will be put to good use as you diagnose issues and implement effective solutions.

If you’re ready to elevate your career in a role that offers both challenge and opportunity, apply today! Your journey towards becoming a key player in our technical team starts here.

• Technical school diploma or equivalent experience
• Background in mechanical and/or electrical fields
• Valid Category B driving license
• Strong problem-solving skills
• Ability to work independently and manage your schedule
• Good communication skills in English
• Flexible and responsible attitude

This large Belgian company plays a key role and manages an extensive and technically complex network. Behind the scenes, high-performing and reliable IT systems ensure that operational processes run safely and efficiently. Within this business-critical environment, significant investments are being made in modern software development and sustainable IT architecture.You will join an experienced team operating in an Enterprise environment where quality, collaboration, and long-term vision are central.
Jobomschrijving
As Lead Full Stack Developer, you take a key role in the further development and evolution of a suite of business-critical applications used in real-time operational environments.You remain strongly hands-on in both backend and frontend development, working primarily with .NET and Angular, while also guiding technical choices, improving existing implementations and helping shape upcoming solutions. You challenge current approaches where needed and translate complex technical topics into clear and pragmatic proposals.A major part of the role is technical leadership. You support and coach other developers, promote knowledge sharing and help maintain high standards in code quality, maintainability and software design. You work closely with analysts, architects, testers and other developers within an Agile/Scrum setup.You also keep a close eye on delivery, scope and technical risks. When dependencies, architectural concerns or implementation issues arise, you identify them early and help the team move towards a robust and sustainable solution.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience in .NET & Angular
•  15 years of experience in IT
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

Your responsibilities 
 

You will provide comprehensive administrative and organisational support to our lawyers.
 

Your responsibilities will include:
 

Matter and document support: opening and maintaining matters in the ERP system; preparing court documents; finalising submissions; monitoring deadlines; ensuring consistent document formatting. Financial administration: preparing and following up invoices; creating purchase requisitions and purchase orders; processing expense reports. Planning and logistics: managing calendars; organising internal and external meetings; arranging travel; coordinating hearing-related logistics. Data and compliance: maintaining CRM records and monitoring lawyers’ professional or bar-related obligations.

Essential
 

At least two years’ experience in an administrative, executive assistant or management assistant role. Excellent written and spoken Dutch and English. Proficiency in Microsoft Office. Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities.  Desirable
 

Previous experience in a law firm or another professional-services environment. Working knowledge of French. Experience with ERP, document management or CRM systems.

Client Details

Michael Page is a globally recognised recruitment consultancy specialising in the placement of qualified professionals and managers across a wide range of sectors, including Finance, Human Resources, Sales & Marketing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Digital & Technology, Legal, and more.

As part of our continued growth in Belgium, we are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to join our Brussels office and contribute to our success while building their own professional career.

Description
Business Development & Sales
• Identify and prospect new business opportunities within your market.
• Develop and manage a portfolio of clients across different industries.
• Conduct client meetings to understand hiring needs and business challenges.
• Negotiate commercial agreements and recruitment partnerships.
• Build long-term relationships with key decision-makers and HR stakeholders.

• Provide market insights and salary benchmarking.
• Ensure a high level of service and client satisfaction.
• Develop long-term partnerships based on trust and expertise.
 

• Previous experience in sales, business development, recruitment, consulting, customer service, or a commercial role.
• Strong interest in business development and client relationship management.
• Entrepreneurial mindset and passion for achieving results.
• Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
• Resilient, ambitious, and motivated by targets and performance.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
• Fluent in French and English or Dutch and English.
• Fluency in French, Dutch, and English is considered a significant advantage.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and electronic issues in trucks

• 
Perform maintenance and repairs, including oil and filter changes, brake installation and bleeding, and component replacements

• 
Handle each assigned vehicle from A to Z, ensuring all required tasks are completed efficiently and accurately

• 
Document all work performed in line with company procedures

• 
Follow established time standards, safety guidelines, and quality requirements

• 
Cooperate with the workshop team and report to the workshop supervisor

• 
Education: Technical qualification or vocational training in truck mechanics or equivalent

• 
Experience: Minimum 3 years of relevant experience as a truck technician or diagnostic mechanic

• 
Driving licence: Category B required (C is an advantage)

• 
Languages: Basic communication skills in English or French

• 
Availability: Occasional on-call duty (once per month); no standard weekend work

Key Competencies

• 
Strong problem-solving ability and technical insight

• 
Team player with a proactive and reliable work attitude

• 
Adheres to safety standards and consistently uses PPE

• 
Open communicator, direct and honest in feedback

• 
Motivated to develop and grow within a professional workshop environment
